question: After allowing a discount of 9% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for ₹53,053. Find its marked price (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 9% discount ⇒ SP = 91% of MP

⇒ 53053 = 91% of MP

⇒ MP = 53053 ÷ 0.91 = 53053 × (100/91)

= 58300

**∴ Answer = ₹58300**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price = ₹53053

Discount = 9%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − discount)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × 0.91

⇒ 53053 = 0.91 × MP

⇒ MP = 53053 ÷ 0.91

⇒ MP = 53053 × (100/91)

⇒ MP = 58300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹58300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

SP = MP × (1 − discount/100)

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ (remaining %)

Quick Tip

Convert percentage to fraction (91% = 91/100)

Key Idea

Divide by remaining percentage after discount
